source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules 1.91 (Items 2.0 stage A) items 7902 and 7903; docs/design/proposals/2026-11-20-items-2.0-design.md section 4 and -tables.md sections 2 to 6.
note: Mode-neutral. A weapon, shield or armour piece belongs to one family (the row's `family`) and is one of its forms (the row's `form`). A family row: id, name, its maker line, its forms (each form's id and, for a weapon family, `teaches`: the technique the form lends while held and teaches at drill mark I) and weapon_art (null until the Weapon Art patch). A form's technique lives here, once: a row names phys.teaches only to override its family's, and tools/validate.py refuses a row that repeats it (packages/engine/src/physical/data.ts weaponTeaches reads the row, then the family). A row with no family is its own family and keeps its own phys.teaches. A form with no `teaches` lends none from the family (a new row's technique is stage B's). mastery_family is a separate key (saved state) and is unchanged.

form_rules.about: Rules 1.91 item 7903: what a melee form hits with and grows with (phys.hits_with, phys.scales_with). A form names one or more patterns; a row of that form matches one of them. A form not listed here is not checked (a form is a label and never overrides a row's numbers).
